CommunityApplications.Profile: UGREEN DXP4800 Pro LEDs for the UGREEN DXP4800 Pro running Unraid. This repository contains the plugin, matching kernel module, sources, licenses and Community Applications metadata. Support and bug reports: https://github.com/EllipticSet/UGREEN-DXP4800Pro-LEDs/issues. Requires Unraid 7.3.2 or later with exact kernel 6.18.38-Unraid.
